name: Channel Requests
description: Lets non-admins request new channels for admin approval, with configurable naming rules and automatic member add.

settings_schema.header:
## Channel Requests

Configure where channel-creation requests are sent for approval. Requests from non-admins are posted to the approval channel, where any System Admin can approve or deny them.

**Naming enforcement (recommended):** define a list of allowed **domain prefixes** below (e.g. team-, project-, ops-). Requesters pick a prefix from a dropdown and supply the suffix, so channels follow the org's naming convention by construction. Falls back to the legacy template + regex settings when the prefix list is empty.

settings.help_text: The URL name (slug) of the team that contains the approval channel. For example, if the team URL is /myteam, enter 'myteam'.
The URL name (slug) of the channel where channel-creation requests are posted for approval. For example, if the channel URL is /myteam/channels/channel-requests, enter 'channel-requests'.

One entry per line: 'prefix|description|optional_suffix_pattern'. When populated, requesters choose a prefix from a dropdown and enter only the suffix — the final channel URL is 'prefix<suffix>'. The optional suffix regex is applied to just the suffix portion (not anchored to '^' or '$'). Leave blank to fall back to the legacy 'Channel URL Template' + 'Channel URL Pattern' fields below. Example: 'team-|Team collaboration channels|[a-z0-9-]{2,16}'.

settings.display_name: Channel URL Template (legacy — falls back when prefixes list is empty)
settings.help_text: Legacy setting. Only applied when 'Channel Domain Prefixes' above is empty. Forces every approved channel URL into a standard shape; use '{{name}}' as a placeholder for the requester's slugified channel name. For example, 'team-{{name}}' turns a request for 'Marketing' into 'team-marketing'.

settings.display_name: Channel URL Pattern regex (legacy — falls back when prefixes list is empty)
settings.help_text: Legacy setting. Only applied when 'Channel Domain Prefixes' above is empty. Regex the final channel URL must match; requests that don't match are rejected. Anchor with ^ and $. Example: '^team-[a-z0-9-]{2,}$'.
